description: COVID-19 Aggregate Hospitalizations Current Weekly County Health is published by Department of Health. The table reports county-level hospital bed availability by care category during COVID-19. Its stated coverage is Pennsylvania, United States; county and date aggregates. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain U.S. Government. Updates ended; airborne-isolation bed fields became null after reporting requirements changed. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
